title: The House of Horrors Halloween Party on Saturday 31 October
preheader: Free entry, fancy dress encouraged and the bar open until midnight.

data.heading: Enter if you dare
body: Our Halloween party is back, and it is a proper local night out. Music all night, the bar open until midnight and a room full of people who have made an effort. Fancy dress is encouraged: go all out or keep it simple, you will be in good company either way.
Entry is free. Let us know you are coming so we know how busy to expect it.

buttons.label: Let us know you are coming

image.alt: The House of Horrors Halloween party at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Fancy dress
rows.value: Encouraged, every level of effort welcome

data.heading: A few things to know
body: Arrive early if you want a good spot, because the pub fills up on Halloween.
Come for dinner first and stay for the party. The kitchen is open from 12pm to 7pm on a Saturday, so eat before the music starts.

data.body: Tell us you are coming and we will keep an eye out for you. Then get planning the costume.
data.cta_label: Let us know you are coming

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
